title: quercus undulata var. gunnisonii
intro: Quercus undulata var. gunnisonii, commonly known as Gunnison's oak, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Fagaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit hepatoprotective and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Gunnison's oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
